optimized_sql:
WITH materialized_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN store_returns AS sr
        ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
       AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
       AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS d1
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS d2
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_year = 2001
      AND d2.d_moy = 8
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip,
    sum(CASE WHEN (mr.sr_returned_date_sk - mr.ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
    sum(CASE WHEN (mr.sr_returned_date_sk - mr.ss_sold_date_sk > 30) AND (mr.sr_returned_date_sk - mr.ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
    sum(CASE WHEN (mr.sr_returned_date_sk - mr.ss_sold_date_sk > 60) AND (mr.sr_returned_date_sk - mr.ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
    sum(CASE WHEN (mr.sr_returned_date_sk - mr.ss_sold_date_sk > 90) AND (mr.sr_returned_date_sk - mr.ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
    sum(CASE WHEN (mr.sr_returned_date_sk - mr.ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM materialized_rows AS mr
JOIN store AS s
    ON mr.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip
ORDER BY
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip
LIMIT 100
